question: In 2006, Ileana Citaristi, an Italian Odissi dancer, was awarded with the ______.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Padma Shri**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• In **2006, Ileana Citaristi,** an Italian Odissi dancer, was awarded with **the ****Padma Shri**.
 
• Ileana Citaristi, an Italian dancer proficient in Odissi and Chhau, as well as a dance instructor based in Bhubaneswar, India, was honored with the 43rd National Film Award for Best Choreography for her work in the film Yugant in 1995. 
 
• Notably, in 2006, she became the first dancer of foreign origin to receive the Padma Shri award for her remarkable contributions to Odissi. 
 
• Additionally, she has been bestowed with the 'Raseshwar Award' by the Sur Singar Sansad, Mumbai. 
 
• Recognizing her significant impact on Odissi, the Government of India conferred upon her the Padma Shri in 2006. 
 
• Furthermore, in 2008, the Italian government bestowed upon her the title of a member of the Order of the Star of Italian Solidarity.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **Padma Bhushan** is a distinguished civilian award bestowed by the Government of India to individuals for their exceptional service and contributions in various fields.
 
• **Bharat Ratna**, India's highest civilian award, is conferred upon individuals for their outstanding achievements and contributions to the nation's progress and welfare.
 
• **Padma Shri, **a prestigious civilian honour, is awarded by the Government of India to individuals in recognition of their distinguished service and significant accomplishments in various spheres.
 
• **Padma Vibhushan,** one of India's highest civilian honours, is bestowed upon individuals for their exceptional contributions and achievements in diverse fields, recognizing their outstanding impact on the nation's development and welfare.
